# thoth_evidence_packs (Data Source)

Lists the workspace's signed evidence packs, newest first. Part locations are left out: download and verify packs with thothctl.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "thoth_evidence_packs" "ready" {
  status = "ready"
}

output "latest_ready_pack" {
  value = try(jsondecode(data.thoth_evidence_packs.ready.data_json)[0].pack_id, null)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `status` (String) Only packs with this status (queued, building, ready or failed).

### Read-Only

- `data_json` (String) Packs as a JSON array: pack_id, period_start, period_end, status, created_at, completed_at, part_count, totals, error.
- `total` (Number) Number of packs returned.
